profile.Civilian Name: Tan Mei Lin; Chen Mei Lin 陈美琳
profile.Civilian Appearance: A woman with long dark-brown hair, usually tied into a low ponytail, warm brown eyes, and a calm, approachable expression. She prefers practical clothing in neutral and earthy colours.
profile.Guardian Appearance: Mangrove wears a forest-green and brown Guardian outfit decorated with delicate leaf and root patterns. Her layered skirt resembles overlapping mangrove leaves, while root-like designs extend along her boots. Her hair becomes a deeper green with subtle golden highlights, and her eyes glow a soft emerald colour.
profile.Transformation Item: Leaf-shaped bracelet with a root-patterned charm
profile.Signature Ability: Mangrove Sanctuary — Mangrove generates extensive root formations capable of stabilising unstable ground, reinforcing damaged structures, and creating natural protective shelters. Her roots can spread through soil, wrap around structures, and redistribute incoming force. They are especially effective in coastal and wetland environments.
profile.Strengths: Defensive magic, terrain stabilisation, environmental awareness, patience, endurance, evacuation planning, teamwork, and maintaining protective formations for extended periods.
profile.Weaknesses: Her abilities consume significantly more energy when she cannot access soil or existing vegetation. She sometimes refuses to retreat while civilians remain within her protective area.
profile.Fear: Being unable to maintain a protective shelter when people are depending on her.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Skyline, Luma Current, Luma Beacon
profile.Loves: Nature, animals, peaceful environments, and spending time with loved ones.
profile.Likes: Gardening, herbal tea, nature walks, helping younger Guardians, and quiet conversations.
profile.Dislikes: Reckless decisions, unnecessary destruction of natural environments, and being rushed.
profile.Hates: Deliberately endangering civilians and exploiting vulnerable people.
profile.Hobbies: Gardening, hiking, nature photography, and environmental volunteering.
profile.Personality: Mangrove is gentle, patient, and quietly protective. She rarely raises her voice and prefers resolving problems through careful observation rather than confrontation. Her dependable nature makes her the stabilising presence within Horizons. Although she is compassionate towards others, she can become extremely stubborn when someone's safety is at risk.
Personality Example: When Beacon becomes overly excited about a new combined technique, Mangrove patiently listens before asking whether anyone has considered the safety risks.
During an evacuation, she calmly reassures frightened civilians while maintaining her barriers, even when the surrounding structures begin collapsing.
When Current jokes about her being the team's mother, Mangrove simply reminds him to eat something before their next mission.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Mangrove becomes unusually dependent on others when feverish. Although she normally takes responsibility for everyone, she becomes quieter and struggles to make decisions. She occasionally seeks reassurance from her teammates and becomes embarrassed when they insist on caring for her.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Mangrove becomes surprisingly talkative and sentimental when intoxicated. She enthusiastically praises her teammates, recalls memories from their earliest missions, and occasionally becomes emotional about how much they have grown. She may insist on hugging everyone while repeatedly declaring how proud she is of them.
profile.Core Idea of character: A Guardian whose strength lies in creating somewhere safe for others to stand.
Quotes: "The roots will hold. You have my word."
"Not every battle needs to be won through destruction."
"As long as someone needs shelter, I will remain."
profile.Background:
Mei Lin developed an interest in nature and environmental protection during her childhood. After awakening as an Earth Guardian, her powers gradually developed towards roots, vegetation, and defensive terrain manipulation.
Her experience in environmental studies helped her understand the practical applications of her abilities, particularly during floods, coastal emergencies, and structural collapses.
She eventually joined Five-Foot Way, where she became one of Horizons' most dependable defensive specialists. Despite her experience, she remains approachable and frequently helps less experienced Guardians improve their defensive techniques.
